maya-sales: Quick — Prospect (FinWave) wants a 1-week POC: swap their legacy streaming call to our SDK. Requirements: structured JSON responses, one function call to their fraud-check, and no visible user errors during cutover. Can we do demo w/o Dedicated?
eric-se: Yes, doable. Recommend starting hosted + shim to keep their surface area minimal. Biggest risks: connection stability and token rotation for webhook auth.
rachel-solutions: For structured output, ask them to provide final JSON schema + 15 gold examples. We'll validate with our pytest harness.
sam-devex: For tool calls, stub the fraud API in our demo env and use HMAC-signed callbacks. That avoids sharing prod creds. For their infra tests we can provide a reverse-proxy pattern.
maya-sales: They asked about latency at 100 rps bursts. Any ballpark?
eric-se: If median request size ~60 tokens, 100 rps -> ~360k tokens/min. With streaming and function-call overhead plan ~1.2x tokens. Hosted should handle this; p50 ~150-250ms depending on model variant.
rachel-solutions: Pricing: hosted demo with bursts typically ~ $600-$1.2k for short run depending on token usage. If they insist on warmed Dedicated it's higher. Offer hosted first.
sam-devex: Quick cURL to show function-call streaming (non-SDK):
```
curl -N -H "Authorization: Bearer $POC_KEY" -d '{"stream":true,"model":"redwood-small","functions":[{"name":"fraud_check","schema":{"type":"object","properties":{"score":{"type":"number"}}}}]}' https://api.redwood.ai/v1/generate
```
SDK handles reconnects + on_function_call callbacks more gracefully.
ops-bot: Infra ticket created: POC-9002. Demo cluster target: 2025-05-13T10:00:00Z.
maya-sales: Action items: Eric -> token sim + failover doc; Rachel -> runbook + acceptance tests; Sam -> demo stub + HMAC example; I'll lock schedule with customer. Please drop artifacts in shared drive by EOD tomorrow.
eric-se: Will do. Short note: include steps to pre-warm KV cache by replaying 500 recent requests or run synthetic warmup.
rachel-solutions: Adding acceptance criteria: 1) schema pass on 15 examples, 2) tool-call handshake success >= 95%, 3) no user-visible errors during canary (<=0.1%).
maya-sales: Thanks all. If blockers surface I'll @channel. :thumbsup:
